summary.text: Kevin Burton is the Republican candidate for Oregon House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democratic incumbent Julie Fahey.
He lists his profession as teacher.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Burton lists his career experience as a teacher and advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Burton said he was born in Nyssa in eastern Oregon, has lived in Eugene since 1986, and has been married for 40 years, with three sons and four grandchildren.
He said he grew up as a farm kid, worked on a charter fishing boat, took part in the Salmon-Trout Enhancement Program, and replanted trees after logging.
Burton said his campaign priorities were education, affordability, jobs, the state budget and homelessness.
He said Oregon's economy has traditionally centered on commercial and recreational fishing, hunting, timber and tourism, and that the state should return to those roots.
